_note: How each pollster fields its polls. mode: live = interviewer-administered phone (CATI); online = web questionnaire. frame: landline / landline+mobile / mobile / online-optin. 'flawed' = true only for methods that cannot produce a usable estimate (no real respondents, undisclosed sampling, push polling); it forces an F. 'concern' is shown but does not change the grade. Sources: zh.wikipedia 2020/2024 presidential poll tables (調查方式 column); poll-tw.com 2026 method cards; my-formosa.com.tw DOC_224921; fsr.com.tw; trs.com.tw; newtalk.tw 2026-06-23/1042863 (ETtoday panel); n.yam.com 20260319490617 (Pearson/TVBS); leho.com.tw 416508; neww.tw/taipei-mayor-poll; storm.mg 4423074 (雨晴).

TVBS.label: Live phone
TVBS.detail: Own call center. Landline + mobile in national polls; most local polls are landline only.

聯合報.label: Live phone
聯合報.detail: Own call center. Landline + mobile in national polls; local polls mostly landline.

ETtoday.label: Online opt-in panel
ETtoday.detail: Questionnaire sent by SMS and email to a registered member pool (about 400,000), quota-sampled and weighted; members get small vouchers. Landline + online in 2020.

美麗島電子報.label: Live phone
美麗島電子報.detail: Fieldwork by 畢肯市場研究. Landline only through 2024; about 70% landline / 30% mobile in 2026.

山水.label: Live phone
山水.detail: Own CATI center with recorded interviews. Mostly landline; adds mobile for some clients.

趨勢.label: Live phone
趨勢.detail: Landline random-digit samples. Also fields polls for 新台灣國策智庫 and 匯流.

匯流.label: Phone
匯流.detail: Landline + mobile nationally; landline in local polls. Some fieldwork by 精確 or 趨勢.

民進黨.label: Live phone
民進黨.detail: Party polling center; landline + mobile. Internal polls are released selectively.

民眾黨.label: Phone
民眾黨.detail: Party polls, often fielded by 求真; landline + mobile. Released selectively.

自由時報.label: Phone
自由時報.detail: Own polling center; method details rarely published. Its 2020 final poll left 27% undecided.

皮爾森數據.label: Online opt-in panel
皮爾森數據.detail: Web questionnaire pushed through a data platform, stratified by sex, age and area. Polls for 鉅聞天下 and 菱傳媒.

新台灣國策智庫.label: Phone
新台灣國策智庫.detail: Fieldwork by 趨勢; landline. Sponsored by a DPP-aligned foundation.

大地民意.label: Phone
大地民意.detail: Polls for 鏡新聞; landline locally, landline + mobile nationally.

雨晴民調.label: Phone
雨晴民調.detail: Landline random-digit sample. Its Kinmen poll was commissioned by the KMT.

信民協會.label: Live phone
信民協會.detail: Fieldwork by 畢肯; about 70% landline / 30% mobile.

循證.label: Phone
循證.detail: Landline + mobile. Sponsored by a DPP-aligned group.

鋒燦傳媒.label: Phone + online
鋒燦傳媒.detail: Landline sample combined with an online questionnaire.

台灣民意基金會.label: Phone
台灣民意基金會.detail: Landline + mobile; some fieldwork by 山水.

放言.label: Phone
放言.detail: Landline; added a 50% mobile sample in 2022 Taipei.
